t: You're looking at numbers 95 to 99 Lancaster Gate, a building in Westminster. It was designed by Sancton Wood, an English architect and surveyor who lived from 1815 to 1886. Wood is best known for his work on railway buildings, so it's interesting to find his name attached to a row of houses here. I don't have more detail about this particular building, but it's a reminder that Victorian architects often worked across very different kinds of commission.
